item.title: “Narrative of Mercy” cultural event held on birth anniv. of Prophet Mohammad
item.description: Commemorating the birth anniversary of the Prophet Mohammad (PBUH), a cultural and artistic event titled “Narrative of Mercy” was held at Tehran’s Vahdat Hall on Saturday (August 29), featuring a performance of the symphony “The Soul of the Word” (Jam-e-Jahan Nama) by Iran’s National Music Orchestra. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, Culture Minister Abbas Salehi, and a number of foreign ambassadors attended the event.

Commemorating the birth anniversary of the Prophet Mohammad (PBUH), a cultural and artistic event titled “Narrative of Mercy” was held at Tehran’s Vahdat Hall on Saturday (August 29), featuring a performance of the symphony “The Soul of the Word” (Jam-e-Jahan Nama) by Iran’s National Music Orchestra. Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, Culture Minister Abbas Salehi, and a number of foreign ambassadors attended the event.

item.title: Persepolis defeats Malavan in Iran Pro League
item.description: The football teams of Tehran’s Persepolis and Bandar Anzali’s Malavan faced each other at Shohada-ye Shahr-e Qods Stadium on August 29, 2026, on Matchday 4 of the Iran Pro League. The match ended in a 3–0 victory for Persepolis.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86249998/Persepolis-defeats-Malavan-in-Iran-Pro-League

The football teams of Tehran’s Persepolis and Bandar Anzali’s Malavan faced each other at Shohada-ye Shahr-e Qods Stadium on August 29, 2026, on Matchday 4 of the Iran Pro League. The match ended in a 3–0 victory for Persepolis.

item.title: Gharibabadi: Implementation of Hormuz understanding with Oman hinges on US’s fulfilling its commitments
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi says implementation of the understanding Iran has reached with Oman concerning arrangements for transit through the Strait of Hormuz hinges on the United States’ fulfillment of its commitments towards the Islamic Republic that Washington has suspended.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86249904/Gharibabadi-Implementation-of-Hormuz-understanding-with-Oman

Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi says implementation of the understanding Iran has reached with Oman concerning arrangements for transit through the Strait of Hormuz hinges on the United States’ fulfillment of its commitments towards the Islamic Republic that Washington has suspended.
